title: Learning Asymptotics with Convergence-Rate Guarantees using Linear Least Squares
abstract: arXiv:2607.23287v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce a new research area that is called Asymptotics Learning Theory (ALT) and combines optimization with asymptotic analysis. In particular, ALT provides a unified approach for computing unknown constants/parameters in proven asymptotic expansions using optimization theory. In this paper, we focus on a general asymptotic form which includes a broad class of asymptotics. Furthermore, we study two powerful numerical methods, namely, sliding Linear Least Squares (sLLSQ) and sliding Tikhonov Linear Least Squares (sT-LLSQ). For these techniques we rigorously prove asymptotic estimates that lead to sufficient conditions for convergence (to the correct values of unknown parameters) and convergence-rate guarantees. Despite their strengths, both methods have also limitations, e.g., slow convergence---or even, counterintuitively, divergence---in some cases. Moreover, we present fundamental applications in analytic combinatorics,

translated_title: 利用线性最小二乘法学习具有收敛速率保证的渐近性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.23287v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们引入了一个新的研究领域，称为渐近学习理论（ALT），它将优化与渐近分析相结合。特别是，ALT提供了一种统一的方法，利用优化理论来计算经过验证的渐近展开中的未知常数/参数。在本文中，我们关注一种通用的渐近形式，它涵盖了一类广泛的渐近性。此外，我们研究了两种强大的数值方法，即滑动线性最小二乘法（sLLSQ）和滑动吉洪诺夫线性最小二乘法（sT-LLSQ）。对于这些技术，我们严格证明了渐近估计，这些估计导致了收敛到未知参数正确值的充分条件以及收敛速率保证。尽管这些方法有其优势，但两者也存在局限性，例如在某些情况下收敛缓慢——甚至违反直觉地发散。此外，我们在解析组合学中展示了基础应用。
tldr: 本文提出渐近学习理论（ALT），通过滑动线性最小二乘及其吉洪诺夫变体，为计算渐近展开中的未知参数提供了统一的优化框架，并严格证明了收敛条件与速率保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Asymptotics Learning Theory (ALT), a unified optimization framework using sliding linear least squares and its Tikhonov variant to compute unknown parameters in asymptotic expansions, with rigorous proofs of convergence conditions and rate guarantees.
